# Release notes

## 7.4 (the autumn 2042 update, current)
- Fixes a rare stall when two questions arrive in the same second.
- Tidies the wording of the facilities queue replies.

## 7.3
- Adds the fan and chiller readings to the status board.
- Retires the old paging integration.

## 7.2
- Moves the queue to the east room hardware.

Release 8.0 has been announced for the annex but has no schedule yet. Until it ships, 7.4 is
the release in service.
